technical_and_design_decisions: Development will be done in Go, the primary language for Hyperledger Fabric.
The library will extend the existing fabric-config or similar channel configuration library, using protobuf for config manipulation.
For capabilities (U5), we will implement toggle methods (e.g., EnableV20ApplicationCapabilities) rather than generic set, to prevent setting unsupported values.
Retrieval functions (U3, U4, U6) will return the corresponding config structs (policies, capabilities, application) to avoid manual parsing.
Example tests will be split into smaller, focused tests per user story (U8), following table-driven test patterns.
All new functions will follow the existing library's signature and error handling conventions.
assumptions: The existing codebase already provides functions to compute a ConfigUpdate transaction and handle signature workflows.
The development environment is set up with all required dependencies (Go, protobuf, Fabric test utilities).
The developer has prior familiarity with Hyperledger Fabric channel configuration and the existing config library.
Effort estimates are based on a single developer working full-time (8 hours per workday).
No external blockers or dependencies beyond the existing codebase are anticipated.

activities.activity_description: Understand existing config library architecture, plan interfaces for new functions, set up development environment and write any boilerplate code.
Code the function to add an orderer endpoint to an orderer org's config group, write unit tests, and update the example test to demonstrate usage.
Code the function to remove an orderer endpoint from an orderer org's config group, write unit tests, and update the example test.
Code the function to retrieve existing policies for a specified organization (application/orderer/consortium), write unit tests, and update example test.
Code functions to retrieve orderer, application, and channel capabilities from a config transaction, write unit tests, and update example test.

Code toggle functions (e.g., EnableV20ApplicationCapabilities, Disable...) to add or remove capabilities for application, orderer, and channel, including validation, unit tests, and example test updates.
Code the function to retrieve the application configuration as a config.Application struct, write unit tests, and update example test.
Code functions to add and remove ACLs in an application group's configuration, write unit tests, and update example test.

activities.activity_name: Refactor Examples and Create Smaller Tests (U8)
activities.activity_description: Split the existing giant end-to-end example into separate, focused examples: orderer configuration update, application values update, organization management, MSP modifications, and capabilities. Ensure all examples are functional and pass.
Run the full test suite including all new and existing tests, integrate components, identify and fix any issues that arise.
Update README with new functions, add inline code comments, perform code review, and ensure consistency across the library.
